reported_symptom: Pick station 5 cannot send totes away; outbound lane full.
investigation_notes: PS5 outbound spur showing overflow. Walked the line and found two totes wedged at merge M2. Photo-eye PE-M2-03 bracket loose, beam angled down onto the belt.
root_cause: Tote jam at merge M2 caused by misaligned photo-eye PE-M2-03.
fix: Cleared jam, re-aimed photo-eye and tightened bracket.

reported_symptom: Totes for aisle 3 not being retrieved; robots waiting at AS/RS port 3.
investigation_notes: Lift in aisle 3 timing out between levels 4 and 5. Encoder readings erratic.
root_cause: Lift encoder connector partially unseated.
fix: Reseated connector, homed the lift, ran test cycles.

reported_symptom: Robots in groups G1 and G2 waiting in the west charging zone.
investigation_notes: C1 showing offline in fleet manager but has power and its display looks normal. Network switch SW-WEST-2 rebooted at 22:24 after a power blip and the charger did not re-register.
root_cause: Charger C1 lost communication after a network switch reboot (charger hardware healthy).
fix: Rerouted G1/G2 to C3 temporarily, power-cycled C1 controller to re-register, restored affinity.

reported_symptom: Robot stopped in aisle A06, two robots stuck behind it.
investigation_notes: R09 in emergency stop with safety field obstruction. Found pallet shrink-wrap on the floor inside the lidar field.
root_cause: Debris (shrink-wrap) in aisle A06 triggered safety stop.
fix: Removed debris, cleared e-stop on R09, blocked robots resumed automatically.

reported_symptom: No new work at any station at start of early shift.
investigation_notes: No waves released since 04:50. WMS nightly replenishment batch still running and holding a lock on the wave table.
root_cause: WMS batch job overran and blocked wave release.
fix: WMS support killed the batch job; waves released manually. Batch rescheduled to 02:00.

reported_symptom: Robot R12 stopped in transit lane TR-1, blocking traffic.
investigation_notes: R12 at 9% battery. Its charge request at 15% was sent during a fleet manager restart and was never queued.
root_cause: Lost charge request after fleet manager restart; robot ran down to critical.
fix: Manually pushed R12 to charger C1. Recommendation: alert when any robot is below 12% and not charging.

reported_symptom: Stations 4 and 6 slowing down; lots of rejected tasks.
investigation_notes: Burst of WCS-402 rejects starting 16:30. All for locations in the L-07 range, which the WMS slotting update re-coded at 16:25. WCS location master not yet synchronised.
root_cause: WMS slotting update sent new location codes before WCS master data sync.
fix: Triggered WCS location master resync; WMS resent rejected tasks.

reported_symptom: Several robots frozen in aisles A07 and A08.
investigation_notes: All affected robots last seen in A07/A08. Access point AP-14 not responding.
root_cause: Access point AP-14 power supply failure.
fix: IT replaced AP-14 power supply; robots reconnected.

reported_symptom: Pick station 2 keeps pausing.
investigation_notes: Repeated light curtain interrupts with nobody reaching in. Receiver knocked out of alignment.
root_cause: PS2 light curtain misaligned.
fix: Realigned light curtain.

reported_symptom: PS5 outbound blocked again.
investigation_notes: Same as INC-0125. PE-M2-03 bracket loose again.
root_cause: Recurring tote jam at merge M2; photo-eye bracket keeps working loose.
fix: Cleared jam and re-aimed photo-eye. Maintenance request MR-2207 raised to replace bracket.

reported_symptom: Robots refusing to enter the new returns zone.
investigation_notes: Map v41 published to fleet manager but 12 robots still on v40.
root_cause: Map update not pushed to all robots.
fix: Republished map v41 and rebooted affected robots in batches.

reported_symptom: AS/RS port 2 repeatedly reporting no tote present.
investigation_notes: Presence sensor lens covered in dust.
root_cause: Dirty tote presence sensor.
fix: Cleaned sensor; added to weekly cleaning list.

reported_symptom: Pick station 3 idle, operators waiting.
investigation_notes: Robots were arriving at PS3 and waiting at the station, but the operator could not confirm picks because the station scanner was offline. Totes present, picks zero.
root_cause: PS3 scanner offline (damaged cable).
fix: Replaced scanner cable.

reported_symptom: Charging slow in west zone; robots waiting longer than usual.
investigation_notes: C3 derating output due to over-temperature. Empty pallet leaning against the charger vents.
root_cause: Blocked ventilation on charger C3.
fix: Removed pallet; C3 back to full output within 10 minutes.

reported_symptom: Rejected tasks building up; stations 4 and 6 short of work.
investigation_notes: Same pattern as INC-0131: slotting update at 16:10, WCS-402 rejects from 16:12.
root_cause: WMS slotting update sent new location codes before WCS master data sync.
fix: Resynced WCS location master. Recommendation: automated check that blocks task release for locations not yet in WCS, plus alert on WCS-402 rate.

reported_symptom: Robot R26 keeps stopping with motor errors.
investigation_notes: Strapping wound around left drive wheel.
root_cause: Debris in drive wheel.
fix: Removed strapping, inspected wheel, returned R26 to service.

reported_symptom: Duplicate task errors after WMS maintenance.
investigation_notes: WMS failed over to standby at 11:58 and resent the last 5 minutes of tasks.
root_cause: Task replay after WMS failover.
fix: WCS discarded duplicates; WMS support corrected replay window.

reported_symptom: Pick station 3 idle for about 15 minutes, operators waiting for totes.
investigation_notes: First checked the PS3 scanner because of INC-0137 (20 minutes lost). No totes were arriving at PS3 at all, unlike INC-0137. Fleet view showed 5 of 7 G3 robots in QUEUED_CHARGE in CHG-EAST with low batteries and 2 more blocked in the east charging corridor behind them. C4 was out of service awaiting a part, so G3 robots could only charge on C2, and C2 had raised CHG-214 at 10:01.
root_cause: Charger C2 output contactor fault while C4 was out of service. G3 charger affinity is east-only (C2, C4), so G3 robots queued for a dead charger and station 3 ran out of totes.
fix: Changed G3 charger affinity to C1 and C3 (west) so queued robots could charge; power-cycled C2, which cleared the fault; restored affinity once C2 was stable. Contactor replaced the following week (MR-2291).

reported_symptom: PS5 outbound full; totes backing up.
investigation_notes: Third M2 jam in three months. MR-2207 (bracket replacement) still open.
root_cause: Recurring jam at merge M2 due to photo-eye bracket.
fix: Cleared jam, re-aimed photo-eye. Escalated MR-2207.

reported_symptom: PS6 picks per hour well below target.
investigation_notes: Wave W-5512 contained mostly bulky single-line orders routed to PS6; robots working normally.
root_cause: Wave composition, not an equipment fault.
fix: WMS team rebalanced the remaining wave across stations.
